entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I see your rehabilitation is going well.

entries.en: You must surely be accustomed to[n]infiltrating Palaces by now?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Hm, I suppose this is a prime opportunity[n]to help further your rehabilitation along.

entries.en: Don't worry... This assignment is not[n]mandatory. Think of it almost as a test[n]of strength.
What's this assignment?
Yeah, whatever.
